cond_0001.intro: A Structural Stick/Mig Welder will weld, fabricate and assist pipe fitters, electricians, millwrights, and ironworks in the installation of varying types of equipment and supports for industrial pipe, structural, electrical and mechanical systems.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Selects equipment and plans layouts, assembly, and welding applying knowledge of geometry, physical properties of metal machining, weld shrinkage, and welding techniques.
Layout, position, aligns, cut, assemble, and fit metal components together in various body positions and in various places.
Bolts, clamps, and tack-welds parts to secure in position for welding.
Sets up equipment and welds parts, using arc, gas-shielded arc, submerged arc, or gas arc welding equipment.
Weld metal materials to piping systems equipment using the appropriate welding procedure for the various equipment and metal types involved.
Identify all equipment for job and process.
Identify all safety risks and requirements.
Other duties as assigned.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Must be able to Stick/Mig weld on various types of equipment and material, HBZ-130-2G, 3G, 4G tests (which is 3 tests and 3 positions).
SMAW (7018-1), Carbon steel plate (.500"" thick) in the 2G (horizontal) 3G (Vertical) 4G (overhead), without a backing strip.
Must successfully pass a weld test.
Must have 4+ years of industrial welding experience.
Must have the ability to stick weld in 2g, 3g, and 4g conditions.
Must be proficient in welding with various rods including but not limited to 6010 & 7018.
Must have a thorough knowledge of various metals characteristics and qualities including the correct welding processes required and the effects of welding on the material.
Must be able to read blueprints and other engineering drawings in order to perform work efficiently.
Must be able to read and interpret technical manuals as applicable.
Must have all required knowledge, skills, and abilities.
Must have all the tools (tool list to be provided).
Must have reliable transportation.
Must be able to work at heights as required.
Preferred Requirements
Experience welding multiple types of material possibly including but not limited to: carbon steel, Fluxcore, stainless, aluminum and chrome.
Must be able and willing to assist with other activities while not actively welding.
Former experience working with [Company name masked].
Previous experience in this position with [Company name masked].

Employee will be required to adhere to large amounts of standing, walking, bending, squatting, sitting and lifting. Will talk and hear to communicate. Will use arms and hands to signal, grab, hold, turn, push, and pull: objects, materials, controls and tools. May be required to pick up, lift, carry and move up to 50lbs. Will work at heights, climb ladders and stairways, and may occasionally work off of platforms/scaffolding using the appropriate fall protection requirements. Must be able to work in all weather conditions (including heat, rain, cold and wind) while wearing appropriate PPE. Will be required to wear personal protective equipment (PPE) including but not limited to: hard hat, safety glasses/spoggles, ear plugs, masks/respirators, hi-vis safety vests, leather gloves and leather steel-toed work boots.

cond_0091.intro: A Structural Stick/Mig Welder will weld, fabricate and assist pipe fitters, electricians, millwrights, and ironworks in the installation of varying types of equipment and supports for industrial pipe, structural, electrical and mechanical systems.
cond_0091.responsibilities:
Selects equipment and plans layouts, assembly, and welding applying knowledge of geometry, physical properties of metal machining, weld shrinkage, and welding techniques.
Layout, position, aligns, cut, assemble, and fit metal components together in various body positions and in various places.
Bolts, clamps, and tack-welds parts to secure in position for welding.
Sets up equipment and welds parts, using arc, gas-shielded arc, submerged arc, or gas arc welding equipment.
Weld metal materials to piping systems equipment using the appropriate welding procedure for the various equipment and metal types involved.
Identify all equipment for job and process.
Identify all safety risks and requirements.
Other duties as assigned.
cond_0091.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Must be able to Stick/Mig weld on various types of equipment and material, HBZ-130-2G, 3G, 4G tests (which is 3 tests and 3 positions).
SMAW (7018-1), Carbon steel plate (.500"" thick) in the 2G (horizontal) 3G (Vertical) 4G (overhead), without a backing strip.
Must successfully pass a weld test.
Must have 4+ years of industrial welding experience.
Must have the ability to stick weld in 2g, 3g, and 4g conditions.
Must be proficient in welding with various rods including but not limited to 6010 & 7018.
Must have a thorough knowledge of various metals characteristics and qualities including the correct welding processes required and the effects of welding on the material.
Must be able to read blueprints and other engineering drawings in order to perform work efficiently.
Must be able to read and interpret technical manuals as applicable.
Must have all required knowledge, skills, and abilities.
Must have all the tools (tool list to be provided).
Must have reliable transportation.
Must be able to work at heights as required.
Preferred Requirements
Experience welding multiple types of material possibly including but not limited to: carbon steel, Fluxcore, stainless, aluminum and chrome.
Must be able and willing to assist with other activities while not actively welding.
Former experience working with [Company name masked].
Previous experience in this position with [Company name masked].
Physical Requirements
Employee will be required to adhere to large amounts of standing, walking, bending, squatting, sitting and lifting. Will talk and hear to communicate. Will use arms and hands to signal, grab, hold, turn, push, and pull: objects, materials, controls and tools. May be required to pick up, lift, carry and move up to 50lbs. Will work at heights, climb ladders and stairways, and may occasionally work off of platforms/scaffolding using the appropriate fall protection requirements. Must be able to work in all weather conditions (including heat, rain, cold and wind) while wearing appropriate PPE. Will be required to wear personal protective equipment (PPE) including but not limited to: hard hat, safety glasses/spoggles, ear plugs, masks/respirators, hi-vis safety vests, leather gloves and leather steel-toed work boots.

Selects equipment and plans layouts, assembly, and welding applying knowledge of geometry, physical properties of metal machining, weld shrinkage, and welding techniques.
Layout, position, aligns, cut, assemble, and fit metal components together in various body positions and in various places.
Bolts, clamps, and tack-welds parts to secure in position for welding.
Sets up equipment and welds parts, using arc, gas-shielded arc, submerged arc, or gas arc welding equipment.
Weld metal materials to piping systems equipment using the appropriate welding procedure for the various equipment and metal types involved.
Identify all equipment for job and process.
Identify all safety risks and requirements.
Other duties as assigned.

SMAW (7018-1), Carbon steel plate (.500"" thick) in the 2G (horizontal) 3G (Vertical) 4G (overhead), without a backing strip.
Must successfully pass a weld test.
Must have 4+ years of industrial welding experience.
Must have the ability to stick weld in 2g, 3g, and 4g conditions.
Must be proficient in welding with various rods including but not limited to 6010 & 7018.

cond_0222.intro: A Structural Stick/MIG Welder will weld, fabricate, and regularly work alongside pipe fitters, electricians, millwrights, and ironworkers in the installation of various types of equipment and supports for industrial pipe, structural, electrical, and mechanical systems.
cond_0222.responsibilities:
Selects equipment and plans layouts, assembly, and welding, applying knowledge of geometry, physical properties of metal machining, weld shrinkage, and welding techniques.
Lays out, positions, aligns, cuts, assembles, and fits metal components together in various body positions and locations, coordinating closely with the crew throughout.
Bolts, clamps, and tack-welds parts to secure in position for welding.
Sets up equipment and welds parts using arc, gas-shielded arc, submerged arc, or gas arc welding equipment.
Welds metal materials to piping systems and equipment using the appropriate welding procedure for the various equipment and metal types involved.
Communicates with the team to identify all equipment needed for the job and process.
Speaks up to identify all safety risks and requirements.
Other duties as assigned.
cond_0222.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
4+ Years of industrial welding experience on industrial size and grade equipment
Ability to Stick/MIG weld on various types of equipment and material; must pass HBZ-130-2G, 3G, 4G tests (3 tests, 3 positions)
SMAW (7018-1), carbon steel plate (.500"" thick) in 2G (horizontal), 3G (vertical), and 4G (overhead), without a backing strip
Must successfully pass a weld test
Ability to stick weld in 2G, 3G, and 4G conditions
Proficient welding with various rods including but not limited to 6010 and 7018
Thorough knowledge of various metals, their characteristics and qualities, correct welding processes, and the effects of welding on the material
Able to read blueprints and other engineering drawings
Able to read and interpret technical manuals as applicable
Must have all required tools
Reliable transportation
Able to work at heights as required
Able and willing to assist with other activities while not actively welding
Must meet all physical demands (see Physical Requirements section)
Preferred Requirements
Experience welding multiple types of material including but not limited to carbon steel, Fluxcore, stainless, aluminum, and chrome
Former experience working with [Company name masked]
Previous experience in this position with [Company name masked]
Current [Company name masked] Certification (all welders will be required to re-test)
Physical Requirements
Employee will be required to adhere to large amounts of standing, walking, bending, squatting, sitting, and lifting. Will talk and hear to communicate. Will use arms and hands to signal, grab, hold, turn, push, and pull objects, materials, controls, and tools. May be required to pick up, lift, carry, and move up to 50 lbs. Will work at heights, climb ladders and stairways, and may occasionally work off platforms/scaffolding using appropriate fall protection. Must be able to work in all weather conditions (including heat, rain, cold, and wind) while wearing appropriate PPE. Will be required to wear PPE including but not limited to: hard hat, safety glasses/spoggles, ear plugs, masks/respirators, hi-vis safety vests, leather gloves, and leather steel-toed work boots.
Required tool list: to be provided

cond_0230.intro: A Structural Stick/Mig Welder will weld, fabricate and assist pipe fitters, electricians, millwrights, and ironworks in the installation of varying types of equipment and supports for industrial pipe, structural, electrical and mechanical systems. People usually grow into this role over time as they build experience with industrial welding and the range of materials and conditions involved.
cond_0230.responsibilities:
Selects equipment and plans layouts, assembly, and welding applying knowledge of geometry, physical properties of metal machining, weld shrinkage, and welding techniques.
Layout, position, aligns, cut, assemble, and fit metal components together in various body positions and in various places.
Bolts, clamps, and tack-welds parts to secure in position for welding.
Sets up equipment and welds parts, using arc, gas-shielded arc, submerged arc, or gas arc welding equipment.
Weld metal materials to piping systems equipment using the appropriate welding procedure for the various equipment and metal types involved.
Identify all equipment for job and process.
Identify all safety risks and requirements.
Other duties as assigned

Must be able to Stick/Mig weld on varies types of equipment and material, HBZ-130-2G, 3G, 4G tests (which is 3 tests and 3 positions).
SMAW (7018-1), Carbon steel plate (.500"" thick) in the 2G (horizontal) 3G (Vertical) 4G (overhead). Without a backing strip.
Must successfully pass a weld test.
Must have 4+ years of industrial welding experience.
Must have all required knowledge, skills, and abilities.
Must be able to meet all physical requirements.
Must have all the tools.

Must be able to read and interrupt technical manuals as applicable.

A large part of the role involves staying in close contact with other trades throughout the workday.
cond_0303.responsibilities:
Selects equipment and plans layouts, assembly, and welding applying knowledge of geometry, physical properties of metal machining, weld shrinkage, and welding techniques.
Layout, position, aligns, cut, assemble, and fit metal components together in various body positions and in various places.
Bolts, clamps, and tack-welds parts to secure in position for welding.
Sets up equipment and welds parts, using arc, gas-shielded arc, submerged arc, or gas arc welding equipment.
Weld metal materials to piping systems equipment using the appropriate welding procedure for the various equipment and metal types involved.
Identify all equipment for job and process.
Identify all safety risks and requirements, and speak up early when concerns arise.
Actively communicate and coordinate with pipe fitters, electricians, millwrights, and ironworks on a daily basis to keep work moving.
Other duties as assigned
cond_0303.requirements:
Must be able to Stick/Mig weld on varies types of equipment and material, HBZ-130-2G, 3G, 4G tests (which is 3 tests and 3 positions).
SMAW (7018-1), Carbon steel plate (.500"" thick) in the 2G (horizontal) 3G (Vertical) 4G (overhead). Without a backing strip.
Must successfully pass a weld test.
Must have 4+ years of industrial welding experience.
Must have all required knowledge, skills, and abilities.
Must be able to meet all physical requirements.
Must have all the tools.
Other Duties as assigned.
Must be able to read blueprints and other engineering drawings in order to perform efficiently work.
Must be able to read and interrupt technical manuals as applicable.
Must have 4+ years of experience welding experience on industrial size and grade equipment.
Must have the ability to stick weld in 2g, 3g, and 4g conditions.
Must be proficient in welding with varies rods including but not limited to 6010 & 7018.
Must have a thorough knowledge of various metals characteristic and qualities including the correct welding processes required and the effects of welding on the material.
Must have experience welding multiple types of material possibly including but not limited to: carbon steel, Fluxcore, stainless, aluminum and chrome.
Must be able and willing to assist with other activities while not actively welding.
Must have reliable transportation.
Must be able to work at heights as required.

Coordinate with team members to select equipment and plan layouts, assembly, and welding, applying knowledge of geometry, physical properties of metal machining, weld shrinkage, and welding techniques.
Work alongside others to lay out, position, align, cut, assemble, and fit metal components together in various body positions and in various places.
Bolt, clamp, and tack-weld parts to secure in position for welding.
Set up equipment and weld parts in coordination with the crew, using arc, gas-shielded arc, submerged arc, or gas arc welding equipment.
Weld metal materials to piping systems equipment using the appropriate welding procedure for the various equipment and metal types involved.
Help identify all equipment for job and process.
Support the team in identifying all safety risks and requirements.
Other duties as assigned
cond_0459.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Must be able to Stick/Mig weld on various types of equipment and material, HBZ-130-2G, 3G, 4G tests (which is 3 tests and 3 positions).
SMAW (7018-1), Carbon steel plate (.500"" thick) in the 2G (horizontal) 3G (Vertical) 4G (overhead), without a backing strip.
Must successfully pass a weld test.
Must have 4+ years of industrial welding experience on industrial size and grade equipment.
Must have the ability to stick weld in 2G, 3G, and 4G conditions.
Must be proficient in welding with various rods including but not limited to 6010 & 7018.
Must have a thorough knowledge of various metals characteristics and qualities including the correct welding processes required and the effects of welding on the material.
Must have experience welding multiple types of material possibly including but not limited to: carbon steel, Fluxcore, stainless, aluminum and chrome.
Must be able to read blueprints and other engineering drawings in order to perform work efficiently.
Must be able to read and interpret technical manuals as applicable.
Must have all required knowledge, skills, and abilities.
Must be able to meet all physical requirements.
Must have all the tools (tool list to be provided).
Must have reliable transportation.
Must be able to work at heights as required.
Must be able and willing to assist with other activities while not actively welding.
Preferred Requirements
Current [Company name masked] Certification (all welders will be required to re-test).
Former experience working with [Company name masked].
Previous experience in this position with [Company name masked].
Physical Requirements
Employee will be required to adhere to large amounts of standing, walking, bending, squatting, sitting and lifting. Will talk and hear to communicate. Will use arms and hands to signal, grab, hold, turn, push, and pull: objects, materials, controls and tools. May be required to pick up, lift, carry and move up to 50lbs. Will work at heights, climb ladders and stairways, and may occasionally work off of platforms/scaffolding using the appropriate fall protection requirements. Must be able to work in all weather conditions (including heat, rain, cold and wind) while wearing appropriate PPE. Will be required to wear personal protective equipment (PPE) including but not limited to: hard hat, safety glasses/spoggles, ear plugs, masks/respirators, hi-vis safety vests, leather gloves and leather steel-toed work boots.

People usually grow into this role over time as they build experience with industrial welding and the range of materials and positions involved.
cond_0509.responsibilities:
Selects equipment and plans layouts, assembly, and welding applying knowledge of geometry, physical properties of metal machining, weld shrinkage, and welding techniques.
Layout, position, aligns, cut, assemble, and fit metal components together in various body positions and in various places.
Bolts, clamps, and tack-welds parts to secure in position for welding.
Sets up equipment and welds parts, using arc, gas-shielded arc, submerged arc, or gas arc welding equipment.
Weld metal materials to piping systems equipment using the appropriate welding procedure for the various equipment and metal types involved.
Identify all equipment for job and process.
Identify all safety risks and requirements.
Other duties as assigned
cond_0509.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Must be able to Stick/MIG weld on various types of equipment and material, HBZ-130-2G, 3G, 4G tests (3 tests and 3 positions).
SMAW (7018-1), Carbon steel plate (.500"" thick) in the 2G (horizontal), 3G (Vertical), and 4G (overhead), without a backing strip.
Must successfully pass a weld test.
Must have 4+ years of industrial welding experience on industrial size and grade equipment.
Must have the ability to stick weld in 2G, 3G, and 4G conditions.
Must be proficient in welding with various rods including but not limited to 6010 & 7018.
Must have a thorough knowledge of various metals characteristics and qualities including the correct welding processes and the effects of welding on the material.
Must be able to read blueprints and other engineering drawings in order to perform work efficiently.
Must be able to read and interpret technical manuals as applicable.
Must have all required tools.
Must have reliable transportation.
Must be able to work at heights as required.
Must be able and willing to assist with other activities while not actively welding.
Must meet all physical demands (see Physical Requirements section).
Preferred Requirements
Experience welding multiple types of material including but not limited to: carbon steel, Fluxcore, stainless, aluminum, and chrome.
Former experience working with [Company name masked].
Previous experience in this position with [Company name masked].
Physical Requirements
Employee will be required to adhere to large amounts of standing, walking, bending, squatting, sitting and lifting. Will talk and hear to communicate. Will use arms and hands to signal, grab, hold, turn, push, and pull: objects, materials, controls and tools. May be required to pick up, lift, carry and move up to 50lbs. Will work at heights, climb ladders and stairways, and may occasionally work off of platforms/scaffolding using the appropriate fall protection requirements. Must be able to work in all weather conditions (including heat, rain, cold and wind) while wearing appropriate PPE. Will be required to wear personal protective equipment (PPE) including but not limited to: hard hat, safety glasses/spoggles, ear plugs, masks/respirators, hi-vis safety vests, leather gloves and leather steel-toed work boots.
Required Tool lists: to be provided

cond_0518.responsibilities:
Selects equipment and plans layouts, assembly, and welding applying knowledge of geometry, physical properties of metal machining, weld shrinkage, and welding techniques.
Layout, position, aligns, cut, assemble, and fit metal components together in various body positions and in various places.
Bolts, clamps, and tack-welds parts to secure in position for welding.
Sets up equipment and welds parts, using arc, gas-shielded arc, submerged arc, or gas arc welding equipment.
Weld metal materials to piping systems equipment using the appropriate welding procedure for the various equipment and metal types involved.
Identify all equipment for job and process.
Identify all safety risks and requirements.
Other duties as assigned
cond_0518.requirements:
Must be able to Stick/Mig weld on varies types of equipment and material, HBZ-130-2G, 3G, 4G tests (which is 3 tests and 3 positions).
SMAW (7018-1), Carbon steel plate (.500"" thick) in the 2G (horizontal) 3G (Vertical) 4G (overhead). Without a backing strip.
Must successfully pass a weld test.
Must have 4+ years of industrial welding experience.
Must have all required knowledge, skills, and abilities.
Must be able to meet all physical requirements.
Must have all the tools.
Other Duties as assigned.
Must be able to read blueprints and other engineering drawings in order to perform efficiently work.
Must be able to read and interrupt technical manuals as applicable.
Must have 4+ years of experience welding experience on industrial size and grade equipment.
Must have the ability to stick weld in 2g, 3g, and 4g conditions.
Must be proficient in welding with varies rods including but not limited to 6010 & 7018.
Must have a thorough knowledge of various metals characteristic and qualities including the correct welding processes required and the effects of welding on the material.
Must have experience welding multiple types of material possibly including but not limited to: carbon steel, Fluxcore, stainless, aluminum and chrome.
Must be able and willing to assist with other activities while not actively welding.
Must have reliable transportation.
Must be able to work at heights as required.
Must meet all physical demands (see section below).
Physical Requirements
Employee will be required to adhere to large amounts of standing, walking, bending, squatting, sitting and lifting. Will talk and hear to communicate. Will use arms and hands to signal, grab, hold, turn, push, and pull: objects, materials, controls and tools. May be required to pick up, lift, carry and move up to 50lbs. Will work at heights, climb ladders and stairways, and may occasionally work off of platforms/scaffolding using the appropriate fall protection requirements.
Must be able to work in all weather conditions (including heat, rain, cold and wind) while wearing appropriate PPE.
Will be required to wear personal protective equipment (PPE) including but not limited to: hard hat, safety glasses/spoggles, ear plugs, masks/respirators, hi-vis safety vests, leather gloves and leather steel-toed work boots.
Required Tool lists: to be provided
